templates.invalidParameters: Invalid tool or parameters for the current phase. Follow the active tool schema.
templates.noScreenshot: Screenshot unavailable; do not claim visual verification.
templates.workspaceID: Supply an exact workspace ID such as workspace_3. If the ID is unknown, use workspace.search.
templates.searchBeforeDelete: To delete a work, use its ID from this delegation's workspace.search results.
templates.activeDelete: Switch to a different workspace before deleting the active work.
templates.invalidEntry: entry must be a workspace-relative file path such as flowchart.html or docs/flowchart.md. Use edit to write the file content.
templates.editExisting: Use edit on the active workspace to create or change its entry file.
templates.enterExisting: Use workspace.enter with that workspace ID to return to it.
templates.pendingRequirements: Newly accepted requirements must be processed before publication.
templates.editedExplanation: Editing has begun; an explanation cannot bypass render and publication.
templates.alreadyActive: This workspace is already active. Existing read references and savepoints still apply.
templates.switchRestored: Switch failed. Previous workspace restored; reread files for fresh references.
templates.previousWorkspace: Previous draft retained. Its read references and savepoints are no longer active.
templates.unavailable: Workspace {{workspaceID}} is unavailable. Use workspace.search to locate an existing work.
templates.alreadyCreated: This delegation already created {{workspaceID}} for this title and entry.
templates.missingEntry: missingFile: The active workspace exists. Call edit(path: {{entry}}, instruction: …) without a read reference to create its entry file.
